582a59dec6ec0e7db72a8fc3a659b17c.overview: After two American prisoners are killed by guards in the act of escaping from a German POW camp in World War II, barracks black marketeer J.J. Sefton is suspected of being an informer.
582a59dec6ec0e7db72a8fc3a659b17c.tagline: The star-spangled, laugh-loaded salute to our P.W. heroes!

583113955fd2fac25426cb57d9e24890.overview: Years after her ship disappeared, a presumably dead woman returns home. To her shock, she finds her husband has remarried.
583113955fd2fac25426cb57d9e24890.tagline: The funniest, fastest honeymoon ever screened!

58451f75955674eab634b0f3c918343d.overview: Activist Bayard Rustin faces racism and homophobia as he helps change the course of Civil Rights history by orchestrating the 1963 March on Washington.

58686c3af641715f1182f6c3dde7cf13.overview: Australian good girl Sandy and greaser Danny fell in love over the summer. But when they unexpectedly discover they're now in the same high school, will they be able to rekindle their romance despite their eccentric friends?

58825b2085a18bbf3c62460e37b3cd72.overview: When struggling, out of work actor Michael Dorsey secretly adopts a female alter ego—Dorothy Michaels—in order to land a part in a daytime drama, he unwittingly becomes a feminist icon and ends up in a romantic pickle.
58825b2085a18bbf3c62460e37b3cd72.tagline: What do you get when you cross a hopelessly straight starving actor with a dynamite red sequined dress? You get America's hottest new actress.

5885221f57f3a05ed38426ee012c3d8a.overview: In a small Japanese town, Ko-Ko is appointed to the unenviable position of executioner. Knowing he must successfully perform before the appearance of the Mikado in a month's time, Ko-Ko finds a suitable victim in Nanki-Poo, who is distraught over his unrequited love for the maiden Yum-Yum. Nanki-Poo agrees to sacrifice his life if he is allowed to spend his remaining days with Yum-Yum, who is betrothed to Ko-Ko.

58913cd9a8c45555874860c767debc23.overview: "Patton" tells the tale of General George S. Patton, famous tank commander of World War II. The film begins with Patton's career in North Africa and progresses through the invasion of Germany and the fall of the Third Reich. Side plots also speak of Patton's numerous faults such his temper and habit towards insubordination.

58994a208be385f38d1344dc7c2963b9.overview: Three teenagers are confined to an isolated country estate that could very well be on another planet. The trio spend their days listening to endless homemade tapes that teach them a whole new vocabulary. Any word that comes from beyond their family abode is instantly assigned a new meaning. Hence 'the sea' refers to a large armchair and 'zombies' are little yellow flowers. Having invented a brother whom they claim to have ostracized for his disobedience, the uber-controlling parents terrorize their offspring into submission.
58994a208be385f38d1344dc7c2963b9.tagline: The nature of reality is entirely up to those who control it.

58a4ab4431f9783d72639159f6d9a8c0.overview: Samuel Fuller’s throat-grabbing exposé on American racism was misunderstood and withheld from release when it was made in the early eighties.Today, the notorious film is lauded for its daring metaphor and gripping pulp filmmaking. Kristy McNichol stars as a young actress who adopts a lost German shepherd, only to discover through a series of horrifying incidents that the dog has been trained to attack black people, and Paul Winfield plays the animal trainer who tries to cure him. A snarling, uncompromising vision, White Dog is a tragic portrait of the evil done by that most corruptible of all animals; the human being.
58a4ab4431f9783d72639159f6d9a8c0.tagline: When man’s best friend becomes his fiercest enemy…

58aed4fa3f7844ebb15a81c1d4b7c652.overview: In the summer of 1947, Britain prepares to commemorate the wedding of Princess Elizabeth and Prince Phillip. To get around food-rationing laws, Dr. Charles Swaby, accountant Henry Allardyce and solicitor Frank Lockwood are fattening a black-market pig for the big day. Egged on by his wife, meek Gilbert Chilvers steals the swine, but the couple must conceal it from inspector Morris Wormold.
58aed4fa3f7844ebb15a81c1d4b7c652.tagline: When a clandestine party goes wild, it's all about pork... and prestige.

58e07401770d3f9a9eb6d61946d6f78e.overview: While protecting an Amish boy—the sole witness to a brutal murder—and his mother, a detective is forced to seek refuge within their community when his own life comes under threat.
58e07401770d3f9a9eb6d61946d6f78e.tagline: A big city cop. A small country boy. They have nothing in common... but a murder.
